let url = URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:12345")!
var request = URLRequest(url: url,
                         cachePolicy: .reloadIgnoringLocalCacheData,
                         timeoutInterval: 10)

let uploadTask = session.uploadTask(withStreamedRequest: request)
uploadTask.resume()
```
